BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS:  BBA   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH:  MGT.   SESSION : SP/2025

SUBJECT: MT318 RETAIL MANAGEMENT
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Specify the special characteristics of retail service. [2] 1 2
Q.1(b) Highlight the economic significance of retailing in India. [3] 1 2


Q.2(a) Differentiate Organised retail from Unorganised retail. [2] 1 3
Q.2(b) Explore the future prospects of retailing in India. [3] 1 4


Q.3(a) Discuss Non-Store based retailing formats with examples. [2] 2 2
Q.3(b) Elaborate  on  types  of  retail  formats  on  the  basis  of their  location  and  the
merchandise variety with the help of an example (retail store) from your city.
[3] 2 4


Q.4(a) State the importance of store layout on the business goals of the retail unit. [2] 3 1
Q.4(b) Highlight the factors behind deciding the store location. [3] 3 2


Q.5(a) Enumerate the types of retail store layout giving examples. [2] 3 2
Q.5(b) State  the  differences  among  retail  units  operated  under  the  following  types  of
ownership structure: chain, franchising and joint venture.
[3] 2 2
